caption: The video captures a wide, still landscape in which a glassy lake mirrors a jagged, snow-dusted mountain range and a sunlit, golden-brown hillside beneath a deep, cloudless blue sky. A small pale building and a clump of dark trees sit on the far shore to the right, while thin bare branches lean in from the edges of the scene. The framing stays essentially fixed, keeping the horizon and the slope in place. Yet the water is not perfectly smooth. Faint ripples subtly disturb the surface, slightly breaking and re-forming the mirror image of the peaks. The white streaks of reflected snow shimmer and shift, and the darker reflection of the hillside smears and settles in gentle waves. This quiet distortion persists in the water, the most noticeable movement in an otherwise tranquil scene.
relations: The static mountains and hillside provide the source for the lake's mirror image.
Faint surface ripples conditionally distort and shift the reflected snow and hillside.
The clear sky maintains a high-contrast backdrop for the shimmering, wave-distorted reflections.
Foreground branches persist, framing the gentle smearing and re-forming of the reflections.
